newsitem.title: DUBAI: Floods kill nine people, damage villages in Iran.
newsitem.headline: Floods kill nine people, damage villages in Iran.

text.p: Nine people were killed in floods that also caused heavy damage to villages and farmlands in northern Iran, the official news agency IRNA said on Thursday.
The floods, triggered by torrential rain since Tuesday, hit villages in Khorasan province and Ardabil, it said.

"Some 20 villages...were heavily damaged as a result of floods on Wednesday, three by over 70 percent...while 2,500 hectares of farmland and 5,000 hectares of pastures were destroyed. Tens of livestocks were also killed," it added.
"Roads and connecting bridges were destroyed in the floods and relief teams are busy carrying out operations using helicopters in several villages," IRNA said.
